concept.title: USB port
concept.shortdesc: Use the USB port to plug in a USB stick.

li.p: You can use a USB cable to connect audio devices to the vehicle’s USB port.
After connecting a media storage device such as an MP3 player or USB drive, you can play music through the vehicle speakers or the infotainment system.
Small electronic devices can also be charged through the USB port. For more details, refer to .
Some devices may not charge when connected to the USB port.
When using a portable audio device connected to the power outlet, noise may occur during playback. If this happens, disconnect the USB cable and use the portable audio device’s own power source.
